turns.text: Like I want to feel like I'm in control of my life, but I just don't think it's that simple.

turns.text: We're dealing with something that's so much more complex that science is trying to gather information, trying to figure out a way to help us, because we are just drowning.
turns.zh: 我们面对的东西复杂得多，科学界正在努力收集信息、想办法帮我们，因为我们真的快被淹没了。
